parameters.formDescription: Upload the CSV export from KBC. Payments are matched to invoices; customers who paid get their access and a welcome e-mail. Lines imported before are skipped.

parameters.query:
-- Keep every bank line. A line that was imported before (same file, same line) is skipped.
INSERT INTO bank_transactions (booked_on, amount, currency, counterparty_name, counterparty_iban, message,
                               balance, source_file, source_line)
SELECT booked_on, amount, currency, name, iban, message, balance, file, line
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
     AS x(booked_on date, amount numeric, currency text, name text, iban text, message text,
          balance numeric, file text, line int)
ON CONFLICT (source_file, source_line) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, booked_on::text AS booked_on, amount, counterparty_name, message;

-- Matched payments: invoice paid, account, access, order paid (all in register_payment, one transaction each).
-- Lines a person has to check get a flag and the reason, so they show up in the admin panel.
WITH m AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
         AS x(tx_id int, invoice_id int, result text, method text, confidence numeric, reason text)
), flagged AS (
  UPDATE bank_transactions b
     SET needs_review = true, suggested_invoice_id = m.invoice_id, match_method = m.method, review_reason = m.reason
    FROM m
   WHERE b.id = m.tx_id AND m.result = 'check'
  RETURNING b.id
)
SELECT r.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM flagged) AS flagged
FROM m
CROSS JOIN LATERAL register_payment(m.tx_id, m.invoice_id, m.method, m.confidence) AS r
WHERE m.result = 'matched';
